caption: The drawing shows two distinct objects on a plain light-colored background. In the upper left corner, there is a small rectangular object with a red border, a white center that has a scalloped edge, and is decorated with pink details and a short pink ribbon extending from each side. Near the center of the image, there is a larger rectangular object that appears to be a closed book or booklet. This object has a black cover adorned with embroidered patterns of flowers and leaves in colors including green, yellow, white, purple, and various shades of pink. The book/booklet is tied closed with a pink ribbon, some of which extends out to the left. The background of the entire drawing is plain and unadorned except for the two mentioned objects.
title: Needle Book
cluster: #01 — Textile Arts: Quilts, Samplers, and Embroideries
